_comment: Example arm for scripts/run-arm.js. Units are the contract's: fee is hundredths of a bip, ticks are V3
ticks in POOL orientation, every amount is RAW base units, seedQuoteWei is wei of WETH.
This cell is ARM ZERO: the reference pad's exact geometry (fee 10000, opening tick 206800, range
[46000, 206800], 1e27 tokens, ZERO quote, no dev buy). It exists to prove the rig reproduces the
population's modal launch before any variable is moved. Copy it and change ONE field per arm -
but NEVER name or symbol. Those are what a human, a scanner and a sniper bot READ, so an
arm-specific symbol would print the treatment assignment on the token itself and confound the
dependent variable. Every arm of an experiment ships BYTE-IDENTICAL text; distinctness of the
deployed addresses comes from the CREATE2 salt block run-arm.js derives from armId.
declareExperiment(keccak256('seed-quote-sweep'), <spec digest>) must already have fired in an EARLIER
transaction or run-arm.js refuses to send anything. Get the digest with:
DIGEST_ONLY=1 ARM=scripts/arm-example.json npx hardhat run scripts/run-arm.js
declaredTx: the declareExperiment tx hash. Leave it null to fall back to a scan anchored on the pad's
deploy block from scripts/deployment-<chainId>.json - never on block 0.
